scientific_integrity: The theorem distinguishes constrained single-hub tuning from previously studied unrestricted onsite-potential existence results, and credits general spectral and Diophantine methods.
scientific_limitations: Classification is complete for rational and transcendental real hub potentials, not for irrational algebraic potentials. Only opposite rim vertices and a single hub onsite control are considered. Numerical checks are corroborating evidence, not substitutes for the analytic proof.
title: A hub-only potential restores antipodal pretty good transfer on the five-vertex wheel, but never perfect transfer
